intro: Talking about proportions and percentages, with an equality comparison.
b1.texto:
- **La mayoría de** + plural group: **la mayoría de los jóvenes**. The verb may agree with *mayoría* (**vive**) or with the people in the group (**viven**).
- Fractions: **la mitad de**, **un tercio de**, **una cuarta parte de** + group or amount.
- Put a determiner before a percentage: **el 20 %**, **un 20 %**, **este 20 %**. The text uses **el** for its specified survey figure. With a plural group after **de**, the verb can be singular or plural: *el 20 % va/van al gimnasio*.
- **Uno de cada tres** means one in every three; use **una** with an all-feminine group. Also: **casi todos**, **muy pocos**, **nadie**.

In conversation, **un montón de** means loads of. To describe figures, use **aumentar/disminuir** or **subir/bajar**. For a comparison, say **el doble de** or **la mitad de** + an amount.

**Igual de** + adjective/adverb + **que** compares equal degrees: *Es igual de alto que su padre*; *leen igual de poco que las mujeres*. It is similar to **tan … como**. To name a source, use **según**: *según la encuesta*.
b2.f0: According to a recent survey, most Spaniards spend more than three hours a day in front of a screen.
b2.f1: Almost all of them have a mobile, and one in three looks at it as soon as they wake up.
b2.f2: Half of young people exercise every week.
b2.f3: On the other hand, only twenty per cent of people over sixty go to the gym.
b2.f4: Men read just as little as women: less than a book a month.
b2.f5: Very few say they have enough free time.
b4.pregunta: Complete: most young people live with their parents.
b5.pregunta: Use the definite article for this previously identified survey figure.
b5.o0.refuerzo: Use el for this definite, specified figure.
b5.o1.refuerzo: Un is possible in other contexts, but the prompt asks for the definite article.
b5.o2.refuerzo: The percentage is singular; use the definite article el.
b6.pregunta: Complete: he is just as tall as his father.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Igual de plus adjective plus que.
b7.pregunta: According to the survey, what proportion of young people exercise each week?
b7.o2.refuerzo: That figure is for people over sixty.
b8.o1.explicacion: De cada is out of every.
b8.o2.explicacion: De cada is out of every.
b9.traduccion: Very few have enough free time.
b10.o0.refuerzo: The plural verb agrees with the students; singular agreement with el veinte por ciento is also possible.
b10.o1.refuerzo: This agrees with el veinte por ciento as a whole, but the prompt asks for plural agreement.
b10.o2.refuerzo: Use third person to agree with el veinte por ciento or los estudiantes.
b11.texto:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (100–120 words).** Write a paragraph describing the habits of people in your country, using la mayoría, la mitad, uno de cada… and percentages.

**Speak (about 2 minutes).** Present aloud the results of a real or invented survey among your friends.
